newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BIL, FCL Paper strong as NZ shares end firmer.
newsitem.headline: BIL, FCL Paper strong as NZ shares end firmer.

text.p: * Buying in leaders picks NZ market up from lows
* FCL Paper firm after U.S. recommendations on paper sector
* Brierley Investments tops turnover, gains three cents ---------------------------(Jan 14)-----------------------------
355 nil * Volume NZ$44 million. Futures -5 at 1,203
Mark Stratford at First NZ Capital said recent recommendations on offshore paper stocks by Merrill Lynch and CS First Boston were helping Fletcher Paper, which gained a cent to $2.97.
"There's been a number of improved estimates for paper stocks and I think that's flowed through here into Fletcher Paper today," he said.

"The bond market here was a bit stronger and that sentiment helped, and basically we saw some buying across leading stocks, but some of the second-line stocks are still not faring particularly well at the moment," he said.
Media stocks were weaker, with INL down 10 cents at $6.85. Appliance maker Fisher and Paykel slipped seven to $5.68 after rising 15 cents on Monday.
